mapper.select: SELECT r.*, m.model_name as modelName FROM warning_record r LEFT JOIN warning_model m ON r.model_id = m.id ORDER BY r.warning_time DESC
SELECT r.*, m.model_name as modelName FROM warning_record r LEFT JOIN warning_model m ON r.model_id = m.id WHERE r.syndrome_type = #{syndromeType} ORDER BY r.warning_time DESC
SELECT r.*, m.model_name as modelName FROM warning_record r LEFT JOIN warning_model m ON r.model_id = m.id WHERE r.status = #{status} ORDER BY r.warning_time DESC
SELECT r.*, m.model_name as modelName FROM warning_record r LEFT JOIN warning_model m ON r.model_id = m.id WHERE r.model_id = #{modelId} ORDER BY r.warning_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warning_record WHERE status IN ('待研判', '已确认', '处置中', '待处置')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warning_record (model_id, syndrome_type, warning_level, warning_content, status, district, hospital, venue, observed_value, baseline_value, threshold_value, anomaly_degree, anomaly_type) VALUES (#{modelId}, #{syndromeType}, #{warningLevel}, #{warningContent}, #{status}, #{district}, #{hospital}, #{venue}, #{observedValue}, #{baselineValue}, #{thresholdValue}, #{anomalyDegree}, #{anomalyType})
